meetings.ours_headline: Appointing Committee reappointed Menard and Simeone and appointed Beardmore to fill a Finance Committee vacancy

votes.motion: to appoint Tim Murphy as Chair
votes.quote: ms. emkey made a motion that mr. murphy be the chair, seconded by ms. brzozoski and the motion was approved.

votes.motion: to appoint Chris Menard and Jay Simeone to three year terms and Peter Beardmore to a two year vacancy commencing upon their swearing in with the Town Clerk
votes.quote: ms. brzozoski made a motion to appoint mr. menard and mr. simeone to three year terms, and mr. beardmore to fulfill a a two year vacancy, all commencing upon their swearing in with the town clerk. ms. emkey seconded and the motion was approved unanimously.

votes.motion: to approve the draft minutes as updated to be typed and filed by the chair
votes.quote: ms. emkey that moved to approve the draft minutes, as updated, to be typed and filed by the chair. ms. brzozosku seconded and the motion was approved.
ms emkey then moved that the meeting adjourn, ms. brzozoski seconded and the meeting adjourned at 6:18pm
